FOR SUPERVISORS

Reassign from the Live monitor: in a channel's drill-down, every item can now be ticked, and Reassign to an agent moves it, including work an agent already has. An email or chat moves to the new agent's inbox with the first agent's capacity given back and its answer time kept; a ticket is transferred with its history; a waiting callback rings the new agent now or waits for them. A call in progress, and work in wrap-up or ringing an agent, cannot be moved, and the pop-up says why on hover. The agent list shows who is available now.

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

Closed queues say so: a closed queue's page reads "This queue is closed: callers and messages are not routed to it", with Open beside it. Changing the opening hours of a closed queue asks whether to open it too. A duplicated queue starts closed, as before, and the confirmation now says so and offers Open it now. The queue list reads Open or Closed.

FIXES

The test-call script shows no timeline for a call that only reached the menu, instead of an error."}
